description: This file defines the MCPToolRegistry class for managing MCP tools, including methods for registering, retrieving, listing, converting, and loading tools from configuration. It also initializes a global registry instance.

classes.name: MCPToolRegistry
classes.description: A class for managing MCP tools, including registration, retrieval, listing, conversion, and loading from configuration.

methods.name: register_tool
methods.description: Registers a new MCP tool with specified name, description, input schema, and handler.

methods.name: get_tool
methods.description: Retrieves a registered MCP tool by name.

methods.name: list_tools
methods.description: Lists all registered MCP tools, optionally filtered by prefix.

methods.name: convert_tools_to_mcp_sdk_tool_type
methods.description: Converts a list of MCPTool objects to MCPToolSDKTool type, if SDK is installed.

methods.name: load_tools_from_config
methods.description: Loads and registers MCP tools from a provided configuration list.
